execution_mode: multi-turn; one verified remote backup commit per turn

mission.goal: Consolidate existing integrators, research accelerators and spatial operators into one capability-routed production solver package while preserving method identities and pursuing a defensible stiff-system CPU performance/significance result.
mission.bottleneck: RODAS5P has eight causal lower-triangular stages; common-W/factorization reuse does not remove the sequential RHS dependency chain.
priority: Test residual-certified speculative rounds with transactional fallback.
Introduce a genuinely stage-parallel stiff peer-W as a separate method if all gates pass.
Reuse 2D and sphere clients; qualify general 3D and sphere MOL separately.
non_goals: Claiming original RODAS stages are independent.
Relabeling source-specific kernels as general solvers.
GPU implementation or benchmark in this short DAG.
Using kernel timing or nominal step count as full-IVP speed evidence.

turns.objective: Optimize original RODAS5P safely and determine whether low-round speculative stage proposals have a nontrivial economic region.

tracks.semantics: Exact RODAS5P equations preserved; parallelize independent RHS rows/components, JVP/operator rows, sparse assembly, preconditioner build, Krylov reductions and legal multi-RHS kernels.
Parallel independent IVPs/parameter samples; each member retains its own controller, norm, history, events and work ledger.
Parallel spatial rows/cells/modes/subdomains at every time stage; report separately from time-stage parallelism.
Batched predictors/corrections are speculative; test original RODAS residual and endpoint/embedded error budget, then rollback and sequential fallback from last accepted state.

For strict-lower 8x8 N, N^8=0 and (I-lambda N)^-1=sum(k=0..7)(lambda N)^k=(I+lambda N)(I+lambda^2 N^2)(I+lambda^4 N^4). Exact algebraic identity only; powers can densify and do not prove runtime speedup.

decisive_gates: T03-A exact affine noncommuting-matrix oracle and predictor-independent endpoint.
T03-B nonnormal/Jordan/official-stage screens with zero false accepts.
T03-C measured Rust batch-cost envelope with robust >=15% break-even margin under uncertainty.
T03-D nonlinear curvature and within-step Jacobian variation map.
T03-E fifth-order and stiff-decay checks including accepted speculative endpoints and fallback.
T03-F controls: block Jacobi, prefix locking, SABR, PTIRK-like, MHC-R, Anderson, binary lift.
T03-G adaptive lambda controller versus fixed schedule.
T03-H full-stage versus goal-oriented certificate; dense output/events covered or refused.
stop_rules: Any false accept stops the affected speculative lane.
No r<=3 economic break-even under measured batch kernels stops further performance implementation of that lane.
Order or stiff-decay loss rejects the fast lane even if fallback masks it.
Source-specific methods remain source-specific unless assumptions are executable and enforced.
turns.backup: Commit all positive and negative gate results; protected RODAS equations stay unchanged.

turns.objective: Define one public problem/solver frontend with capability negotiation while preserving each method's distinct lifecycle.
requirements: Common Problem: state/vector-space semantics, t-span/direction, mass operator, RHS, time derivative, derivative provider and callback replay/thread-safety declarations.
Derivative provider distinguishes assembled J, analytic/AD JVP, finite-difference JVP, source-owned structured operator and absent derivative.

MethodDescriptor carries method/tableau ID, one/two-step history, stage DAG, order/stage order, stability domain, estimator, startup, step-ratio domain, shifts/preconditioners, dense output, events, backward and geometry constraints.
StepAttempt carries candidate state/history, accept/reject/fail, estimator, next h, dense segment, event information, typed failure and WorkDelta.
Commit/rollback/checkpoint is transactional; a rejected attempt cannot mutate committed state/history.
Fallback restores last accepted state, invalidates caches on method/operator/mesh changes and charges speculative plus fallback work.
Capability query is callback-free; explicit selection outranks Auto; reference-only methods excluded from production Auto.
Keep DOPRI5 and RODAS5P public APIs as compatibility wrappers during migration.
acceptance: Contract tests cover shape, units, mass, derivative semantics and callback replay/thread safety.
Capability query calls no user callbacks.

evidence_contract.performance: Synthetic/kernel timing, observed concurrency and accepted-step count alone are not full-IVP performance evidence.

rules: Original RODAS5P strict-lower stage equations remain dependent.
For strict-lower 8x8 N, N^8=0 and finite inverse/binary factorization are exact algebraic identities, not speedup theorem.
JVP is derivative action; matrix-free is not derivative-free; FD-JVP is approximate differentiation.
Newton-free does not mean solve-free or globally convergent.
Peer-W is a distinct two-step method with own startup/history/estimator/restart.
Stage reuse does not prove stage independence.
Constant-step spectral radius is not a variable-step norm proof.
Algebraic residual is not LTE bound without inverse/Lipschitz/output propagation.
Affine prefix scan parallelizes supplied recurrence, not nonlinear adaptive trajectory.
P06/Gray-Scott clients are not a general spatial backend.
Source-specific Fourier invariant leaf is not generic spectral solver.
Published table is not implemented or runtime-qualified method.
Preserve PR187 slowdown, R6/R7 slowdowns, PP05/PP06 failures and PP15 no-timing.
stop: Two turns with no reproducible progress.
One independent adversarial review only; no review-of-review recursion.
